strategies.name: Baseline Sequential All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Executes 8 consecutive all-reduce operations (one per stage) with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling and uncoupling transformations. Total of 8 all-reduce dispatches with full W*S payload each. Represents the straightforward implementation with no fusion or optimization—highest dispatch count but simplest structure.

strategies.name: Fused Local-Op Batching Between Collectives
strategies.desc: Groups the forward bidiagonal coupling and backward uncoupling into vectorized operations that process multiple shards simultaneously using strided views or tensor reshaping, reducing local compute overhead between the 8 all-reduce calls. Still 8 dispatches but optimizes the CPU/local computation bottleneck through better memory access patterns and potential SIMD utilization.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replaces each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter followed by all-gather pair (16 total collective dispatches), allowing each rank to own and process only its shard during local coupling/uncoupling phases. Reduces intermediate buffer sizes from W*S to S, trading 2x collective count for better memory locality and bandwidth efficiency on large world sizes.

strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapped Communication-Computation
strategies.desc: Splits the W*S tensor into chunks and issues non-blocking all-reduce operations on successive chunks while computing bidiagonal transforms on already-reduced chunks from prior stages. Requires async collective support; total dispatches increase (8*num_chunks) but latency can be hidden through overlap, trading dispatch count for wall-clock time reduction.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction Tree
strategies.desc:
Exploits multi-node topology by performing intra-node all-reduce (within each node's devices) followed by inter-node all-reduce, repeated for all 8 stages. For 224 ranks across multiple nodes, this reduces cross-node traffic and leverages faster intra-node interconnects (NVLink/ICI). Total dispatches are 16 (8 stages × 2 levels) with smaller payloads on the inter-node phase.
